# Initial heap diagnostic checks compiler-emitted accesses independently of
# the package-state builder. These deliberately privileged test helpers attach
# runtime groups and expose foreign pointers; application transport cannot do so.

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "reflect"
    "runtime"
    "sync/atomic"
    "strings"
    "unsafe"
    "example.org/isolateheap/bridge"
)

//go:linkname newGroup runtime.isolateNewGroup
func newGroup() unsafe.Pointer
//go:linkname setGroup runtime.isolateSetGroup
func setGroup(unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer
//go:linkname setOwner runtime.isolateSetOwner
func setOwner(uintptr) uintptr

type record struct { Data [64]int }
type holder struct {
    Pointer *record
    Bytes []byte
    Any any
    Function func() int
    Padding [64]int
}
type mapKey struct { A, B *record }
var published *record
//go:noinline
func allocate() *record { return &record{Data: [64]int{11}} }
//go:noinline
func allocateTypes() *[7]reflect.Type { return new([7]reflect.Type) }
//go:noinline
func allocatePanic() *any { return new(any) }
//go:noinline
func allocateFields() *[2]reflect.StructField { return new([2]reflect.StructField) }
//go:noinline
func allocateKey() *mapKey { return new(mapKey) }
//go:noinline
func assignGenericKey(m map[mapKey]int, p *mapKey) { m[*p] = 19 }
//go:noinline
func allocatePointers(p *record, length int) []*record {
    result := make([]*record, length)
    for i := range result { result[i] = p }
    return result
}
//go:noinline
func read(p *record) int { return p.Data[7] }
//go:noinline
func write(p *record) { p.Data[7] = 19 }
//go:noinline
func move(dst, src *record) { *dst = *src }
//go:noinline
func sliceRead(p []int) int { return p[7] }
//go:noinline
func sliceWrite(p []int) { p[7] = 19 }
//go:noinline
func tuple() (record, int, error) { return *allocate(), 27, nil }
//go:noinline
func tupleHeap(p *record, number *int, err *error) { *p, *number, *err = tuple() }
//go:noinline
func tupleReferences() (holder, int, error) {
    return holder{Pointer: allocate(), Bytes: []byte{7, 8}, Any: allocate(), Function: capture(39)}, 41, nil
}
//go:noinline
func tupleReferencesHeap(p *holder, number *int, err *error) { *p, *number, *err = tupleReferences() }
//go:noinline
func copyBytes(dst, src []byte) int { return copy(dst, src) }
//go:noinline
func copyPointers(dst, src []*record) int { return copy(dst, src) }
//go:noinline
func clonePointers(src []*record) []*record { dst := make([]*record, len(src)); copy(dst, src); return dst }
//go:noinline
func cloneBytes(src []byte) []byte { dst := make([]byte, len(src)); copy(dst, src); return dst }
//go:noinline
func appendBytes(src []byte) []byte { return append(src, 19) }
//go:noinline
func appendPointers(src []*record) []*record { return append(src, nil) }
//go:noinline
func clearBytes(dst []byte) { clear(dst) }
//go:noinline
func bytesString(src []byte) string { return string(src) }
//go:noinline
func runesString(src []rune) string { return string(src) }
//go:noinline
func stringBytes(src string) []byte { return []byte(src) }
//go:noinline
func stringRunes(src string) []rune { return []rune(src) }
//go:noinline
func mapMissing(m map[string]int) int { return m["missing"] }
//go:noinline
func mapLen(m map[string]int) int { return len(m) }
//go:noinline
func mapRange(m map[string]int) { for range m {} }
//go:noinline
func mapWrite(m map[string]int) { m["key"] = 27 }
//go:noinline
func mapDelete(m map[string]int) { delete(m, "key") }
//go:noinline
func mapClear(m map[string]int) { clear(m) }
//go:noinline
func chanSend(c chan int) { c <- 27 }
//go:noinline
func chanRecv(c chan int) int { return <-c }
//go:noinline
func chanClose(c chan int) { close(c) }
//go:noinline
func chanLen(c chan int) int { return len(c) + cap(c) }
//go:noinline
func channelSelect(local, foreign chan int) {
    select { case <-local: case <-foreign: default: }
}
//go:noinline
func capture(value int) func() int { return func() int { return value } }
//go:noinline
func moveHolder(dst, src *holder) { *dst = *src }
//go:noinline
func publishStatic(value *record) { published = value }
//go:noinline
func atomicAddress(p *record) *int64 { return (*int64)(unsafe.Pointer(&p.Data[7])) }
//go:noinline
func allocateAtomic() *atomic.Int64 { return new(atomic.Int64) }
//go:noinline
func allocateAtomicPointer() *atomic.Pointer[record] { return new(atomic.Pointer[record]) }
//go:noinline
func allocatePointer() *unsafe.Pointer { return new(unsafe.Pointer) }
//go:noinline
func atomicNil() {
    defer func() { if recover() == nil { panic("nil atomic destination did not panic") } }()
    atomic.StorePointer(nil, nil)
}
//go:noinline
func atomicPublish(source *record, operation int) {
    target := allocatePointer()
    defer func() {
        if atomic.LoadPointer(target) != nil { panic("foreign pointer atomically published") }
    }()
    switch operation {
    case 0: atomic.StorePointer(target, unsafe.Pointer(source))
    case 1: atomic.SwapPointer(target, unsafe.Pointer(source))
    case 2: atomic.CompareAndSwapPointer(target, nil, unsafe.Pointer(source))
    case 3:
        typed := allocateAtomicPointer()
        defer func() { if typed.Load() != nil { panic("foreign typed pointer atomically published") } }()
        typed.Store(source)
    }
}

// Result slots in a function with a defer are live to GC from function entry.
// Nested frames and pointer-free stack contents exercise stack growth/reuse;
// initialization must precede checks of captured values and must not emit calls.
//go:noinline
func resultClosure(value *record) func(int) (error, *record, []byte, string, any, [1]*record) {
    return func(depth int) (err error, p *record, b []byte, s string, a any, array [1]*record) {
        defer func() {
            if err != nil || p != nil || b != nil || s != "" || a != nil || array[0] != nil {
                panic("result initialization changed")
            }
        }()
        if value.Data[0] != 11 { panic("closure argument changed") }
        if depth > 0 { resultFrames(depth - 1, value) }
        return
    }
}
//go:noinline
func resultFrames(depth int, value *record) {
    var dirty [128]uintptr
    for i := range dirty { dirty[i] = uintptr(i + 1) }
    err, p, b, s, a, array := resultClosure(value)(depth)
    if err != nil || p != nil || b != nil || s != "" || a != nil || array[0] != nil {
        panic("result values changed")
    }
    runtime.KeepAlive(dirty)
}

func run(owner uintptr, fn func()) {
    group := newGroup()
    previousGroup := setGroup(group)
    previousOwner := setOwner(owner)
    defer setGroup(previousGroup)
    defer setOwner(previousOwner)
    fn()
}

func main() {
    host := allocate()
    hostMap := map[string]int{"key": 42}
    hostChan := make(chan int, 2)
    hostChan <- 11
    hostBytes := make([]byte, 16)
    hostBytes[0] = 7
    hostPointers := allocatePointers(host, 2)
    hostFunction := capture(11)
    hostKey := strings.Repeat("ForeignKey", 17)
    hostRunes := []rune(hostKey)
    hostAtomic := allocateAtomic()
    hostPointer := allocatePointer()
    atomic.StorePointer(hostPointer, unsafe.Pointer(host))
    var owned *record
    run(101, func() { owned = allocate() })
    defer func() {
        if got := recover(); got != nil {
            // The rejected operation must not have mutated the host object.
            if host.Data[7] != 0 { panic("foreign write happened before checking") }
            if len(hostChan) != 1 { panic("foreign channel changed before checking") }
            if hostMap["key"] != 42 { panic("foreign map changed before checking") }
            for i, b := range hostBytes {
                want := byte(0)
                if i == 0 { want = 7 }
                if b != want { panic("foreign byte copy changed destination") }
            }
            if hostPointers[0] != host || hostPointers[1] != host { panic("foreign pointer copy changed destination") }
            if published != nil { panic("foreign reference escaped before checking") }
            if hostAtomic.Load() != 0 || atomic.LoadPointer(hostPointer) != unsafe.Pointer(host) {
                panic("foreign atomic destination changed")
            }
            run(101, func() {
                if owned.Data[7] != 0 { panic("foreign atomic peer changed") }
            })
            hostChan <- 12 // A rejected close must not have closed this channel.
            fmt.Println(got)
        }
    }()
    switch os.Args[1] {
    case "convert-bytes": run(104, func() { bytesString(hostBytes) })
    case "convert-runes": run(104, func() { runesString(hostRunes) })
    case "convert-string-bytes": run(104, func() { stringBytes(hostKey) })
    case "convert-string-runes": run(104, func() { stringRunes(hostKey) })
    case "convert-own": run(104, func() {
        text := strings.Repeat("PrivateλKey", 17)
        if bytesString(stringBytes(text)) != text || runesString(stringRunes(text)) != text {
            panic("owned conversions changed")
        }
        if bytesString(nil) != "" || runesString(nil) != "" || len(stringBytes("")) != 0 || len(stringRunes("")) != 0 {
            panic("empty conversions changed")
        }
        if runesString([]rune{-1, 0x110000}) != "��" || len(stringRunes(bytesString([]byte{0xff}))) != 1 {
            panic("invalid UTF-8 conversion changed")
        }
    })
    case "map-key-string-insert": run(104, func() {
        m := make(map[string]int)
        defer func() { if len(m) != 0 { panic("foreign string key inserted") } }()
        m[hostKey] = 19
    })
    case "map-key-string-read": run(104, func() {
        m := map[string]int{"local": 27}
        _ = m[hostKey]
    })
    case "map-key-string-delete": run(104, func() {
        m := map[string]int{"local": 27}
        defer func() { if len(m) != 1 || m["local"] != 27 { panic("map changed before key validation") } }()
        delete(m, hostKey)
    })
    case "map-key-pointer": run(104, func() {
        m := make(map[*record]int)
        defer func() { if len(m) != 0 { panic("foreign pointer key inserted") } }()
        m[host] = 19
    })
    case "map-key-generic": run(104, func() {
        m := make(map[mapKey]int)
        defer func() { if len(m) != 0 { panic("foreign generic key inserted") } }()
        key := allocateKey()
        bridge.Set((*unsafe.Pointer)(unsafe.Pointer(&key.A)), unsafe.Pointer(host))
        assignGenericKey(m, key)
    })
    case "map-key-own": run(104, func() {
        value := allocate()
        pointers := make(map[*record]int)
        pointers[value] = 19
        if pointers[value] != 19 { panic("owned pointer key changed") }
        delete(pointers, value)
        generic := make(map[mapKey]int)
        key := allocateKey()
        key.A, key.B = value, value
        assignGenericKey(generic, key)
        if generic[*key] != 19 { panic("owned generic key changed") }
        delete(generic, *key)
        text := strings.Repeat("PrivateKey", 17)
        texts := make(map[string]int)
        texts[text] = 27
        if texts[text] != 27 { panic("owned string key changed") }
        delete(texts, text)
        canonical := reflect.ArrayOf(31, reflect.TypeFor[int]())
        types := make(map[reflect.Type]int)
        types[canonical] = 39
        if types[canonical] != 39 { panic("canonical type key changed") }
    })
    case "atomic-load": run(104, func() { atomic.LoadInt64(atomicAddress(host)) })
    case "atomic-store": run(104, func() { atomic.StoreInt64(atomicAddress(host), 19) })
    case "atomic-add": run(104, func() { atomic.AddInt64(atomicAddress(host), 19) })
    case "atomic-swap": run(104, func() { atomic.SwapInt64(atomicAddress(host), 19) })
    case "atomic-cas": run(104, func() { atomic.CompareAndSwapInt64(atomicAddress(host), 0, 19) })
    case "atomic-and": run(104, func() { atomic.AndInt64(atomicAddress(host), 0) })
    case "atomic-or": run(104, func() { atomic.OrInt64(atomicAddress(host), 19) })
    case "atomic-typed": run(104, func() { hostAtomic.Store(19) })
    case "atomic-peer-store": run(104, func() { atomic.StoreInt64(atomicAddress(owned), 19) })
    case "atomic-instance-load": atomic.LoadInt64(atomicAddress(owned))
    case "atomic-pointer-load": run(104, func() { atomic.LoadPointer(hostPointer) })
    case "atomic-pointer-store": run(104, func() { atomic.StorePointer(hostPointer, nil) })
    case "atomic-pointer-publish": run(104, func() { atomicPublish(host, 0) })
    case "atomic-pointer-swap-publish": run(104, func() { atomicPublish(host, 1) })
    case "atomic-pointer-cas-publish": run(104, func() { atomicPublish(host, 2) })
    case "atomic-typed-publish": run(104, func() { atomicPublish(host, 3) })
    case "atomic-instance-publish": atomicPublish(owned, 0)
    case "atomic-own": run(104, func() {
        atomicNil()
        scalar := allocateAtomic()
        scalar.Store(11)
        if scalar.Load() != 11 || scalar.Add(8) != 19 || scalar.Swap(27) != 19 || !scalar.CompareAndSwap(27, 31) || scalar.And(15) != 31 || scalar.Or(16) != 15 || scalar.Load() != 31 {
            panic("owned atomic values changed")
        }
        small := new(atomic.Int32)
        small.Store(11)
        if small.Load() != 11 || small.Add(8) != 19 || small.Swap(27) != 19 || !small.CompareAndSwap(27, 31) || small.And(15) != 31 || small.Or(16) != 15 { panic("owned 32-bit atomics changed") }
        boolean := new(atomic.Bool)
        if boolean.Load() || !boolean.CompareAndSwap(false, true) || !boolean.Swap(false) { panic("owned boolean atomics changed") }
        word := new(atomic.Uintptr)
        word.Store(11)
        if word.Load() != 11 || word.Add(8) != 19 || word.Swap(27) != 19 || !word.CompareAndSwap(27, 31) { panic("owned uintptr atomics changed") }
        typed := allocateAtomicPointer()
        value := allocate()
        typed.Store(value)
        if typed.Load() != value || typed.Swap(nil) != value || !typed.CompareAndSwap(nil, value) { panic("owned atomic pointers changed") }
        canonical := allocatePointer()
        atomic.StorePointer(canonical, reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ArrayOf(23, reflect.TypeFor[int]())).UnsafePointer())
    })
    case "entry-results":
        done := make(chan struct{})
        gcStopped := make(chan struct{})
        go func() {
            defer close(gcStopped)
            for {
                select { case <-done: return; default: runtime.GC() }
            }
        }()
        run(104, func() {
            value := allocate()
            for i := 0; i < 64; i++ { resultFrames(32, value) }
        })
        close(done)
        <-gcStopped
    case "metadata-strings":
        run(104, func() {
            typ := reflect.StructOf([]reflect.StructField{
                {Name: "OwnedName", Type: reflect.TypeFor[int](), Tag: `json:"owned_name"`},
                {Name: "hidden", Type: reflect.TypeFor[int](), PkgPath: "example.org/metadata/private"},
            })
            fields := allocateFields()
            fields[0], fields[1] = typ.Field(0), typ.Field(1)
            text := allocatePanic()
            *text = typ.String()
            if fields[0].Name != "OwnedName" || string(fields[0].Tag) != `json:"owned_name"` || fields[1].PkgPath != "example.org/metadata/private" || (*text).(string) == "" {
                panic("metadata strings changed")
            }
        })
    case "metadata-panic":
        run(104, func() {
            payload := allocatePanic()
            func() {
                defer func() { *payload = recover() }()
                reflect.StructOf([]reflect.StructField{{Name: "123invalid", Type: reflect.TypeFor[int]()}})
            }()
            if *payload != "reflect.StructOf: field 0 has invalid name" { panic("metadata panic payload") }
        })
    case "metadata":
        run(104, func() {
            array := reflect.ArrayOf(1001, reflect.TypeFor[int]())
            record := reflect.StructOf([]reflect.StructField{{Name: "Value", Type: array}})
            types := []reflect.Type{array, record, reflect.PointerTo(record), reflect.SliceOf(record),
                reflect.ChanOf(reflect.BothDir, record), reflect.MapOf(reflect.TypeFor[string](), record),
                reflect.FuncOf([]reflect.Type{record}, []reflect.Type{array}, false)}
            target := allocateTypes()
            for i, typ := range types { target[i] = typ }
            if copy(target[:], types) != len(types) { panic("metadata copy") }
            for i, typ := range target {
                if typ != types[i] || typ.String() == "" { panic("metadata identity") }
            }
        })
    case "metadata-write":
        run(104, func() {
            typ := reflect.ArrayOf(1001, reflect.TypeFor[int]())
            root := reflect.ValueOf(typ).UnsafePointer()
            *(*byte)(root) = 0
        })
    case "metadata-interior":
        run(104, func() {
            typ := reflect.ArrayOf(1001, reflect.TypeFor[int]())
            root := reflect.ValueOf(typ).UnsafePointer()
            target := new(unsafe.Pointer)
            *target = unsafe.Add(root, 1)
        })
    case "own":
        run(102, func() { p := allocate(); write(p); if read(p) != 19 { panic("own state") } })
        run(103, func() {
            data := []byte{1,2,3,4}
            if copyBytes(data[1:], data) != 3 || data[3] != 3 { panic("overlapping copy") }
            if copyBytes(nil, data) != 0 || copyBytes(data, nil) != 0 { panic("empty copy") }
            data = appendBytes(data)
            if data[4] != 19 || cloneBytes(data)[4] != 19 { panic("own byte append") }
            clearBytes(data)
            if data[4] != 0 { panic("own clear") }
            refs := []*record{allocate(), allocate()}
            if clonePointers(refs)[1] != refs[1] || appendPointers(refs)[1] != refs[1] { panic("own pointer copy") }
            p, number, err := new(record), new(int), new(error)
            tupleHeap(p, number, err)
            if p.Data[0] != 11 || *number != 27 || *err != nil { panic("tuple result") }
            m := map[string]int{"key": 42}
            if mapMissing(m) != 0 || mapLen(m) != 1 { panic("own map") }
            mapRange(m)
            mapWrite(m)
            mapDelete(m)
            mapClear(m)
            c := make(chan int, 2)
            chanSend(c)
            if chanRecv(c) != 27 || chanLen(c) != 2 { panic("own channel") }
            channelSelect(c, nil)
            chanClose(c)
            if mapMissing(nil) != 0 || mapLen(nil) != 0 || chanLen(nil) != 0 { panic("nil semantics") }
            source := &holder{Pointer: allocate(), Bytes: make([]byte, 16), Any: allocate(), Function: capture(31)}
            target := new(holder)
            moveHolder(target, source)
            if target.Pointer != source.Pointer || target.Function() != 31 { panic("own references") }
            tupleReferencesHeap(target, number, err)
            if target.Pointer.Data[0] != 11 || target.Bytes[1] != 8 || target.Any.(*record).Data[0] != 11 || target.Function() != 39 || *number != 41 || *err != nil {
                panic("pointer-bearing tuple result")
            }
        })
    case "copy-host-read": run(102, func() { copyBytes(make([]byte, 16), hostBytes) })
    case "copy-host-write": run(102, func() { copyBytes(hostBytes, []byte{8, 9}) })
    case "copy-pointer-host-read": run(102, func() { copyPointers(make([]*record, 2), hostPointers) })
    case "copy-pointer-host-write": run(102, func() { copyPointers(hostPointers, []*record{allocate()}) })
    case "make-copy-host": run(102, func() { _ = cloneBytes(hostBytes) })
    case "append-host-growth": run(102, func() { _ = appendBytes(hostBytes) })
    case "append-host-inplace": run(102, func() { _ = appendBytes(hostBytes[:8]) })
    case "clear-host": run(102, func() { clearBytes(hostBytes) })
    case "copy-publish", "make-copy-publish", "append-publish": run(102, func() {
        source := make([]*record, 10000)
        source[0] = allocate()
        bridge.Set((*unsafe.Pointer)(unsafe.Pointer(&source[9999])), unsafe.Pointer(host))
        target := make([]*record, len(source))
        defer func() { for _, p := range target { if p != nil { panic("partial copy before rejection") } } }()
        switch os.Args[1] {
        case "copy-publish": copyPointers(target, source)
        case "make-copy-publish": _ = clonePointers(source)
        case "append-publish": _ = appendPointers(source)
        }
    })
    case "host-read": run(102, func() { read(host) })
    case "host-write": run(102, func() { write(host) })
    case "instance-read": read(owned)
    case "instance-write": write(owned)
    case "peer-read": run(102, func() { read(owned) })
    case "bulk-read": run(102, func() { move(allocate(), host) })
    case "bulk-write": run(102, func() { move(host, allocate()) })
    case "slice-read": run(102, func() { sliceRead(host.Data[:]) })
    case "slice-write": run(102, func() { sliceWrite(host.Data[:]) })
    case "map-missing": run(102, func() { mapMissing(hostMap) })
    case "map-len": run(102, func() { mapLen(hostMap) })
    case "map-range": run(102, func() { mapRange(hostMap) })
    case "map-write": run(102, func() { mapWrite(hostMap) })
    case "map-delete": run(102, func() { mapDelete(hostMap) })
    case "map-clear": run(102, func() { mapClear(hostMap) })
    case "chan-send": run(102, func() { chanSend(hostChan) })
    case "chan-recv": run(102, func() { chanRecv(hostChan) })
    case "chan-close": run(102, func() { chanClose(hostChan) })
    case "chan-len": run(102, func() { chanLen(hostChan) })
    case "select": run(102, func() {
        ready := make(chan int, 1)
        ready <- 1
        channelSelect(ready, hostChan)
    })
    case "publish-pointer": run(102, func() { p := new(holder); p.Pointer = owned })
    case "publish-slice": run(102, func() { p := new(holder); p.Bytes = hostBytes })
    case "publish-interface": run(102, func() { p := new(holder); p.Any = host })
    case "publish-closure": run(102, func() { p := new(holder); p.Function = hostFunction })
    case "publish-bulk": run(102, func() {
        source, target := new(holder), new(holder)
        // Deliberately bypass instrumented stores to manufacture the invalid
        // graph being tested. Its outer object still belongs to this instance.
        bridge.Set((*unsafe.Pointer)(unsafe.Pointer(&source.Pointer)), unsafe.Pointer(host))
        moveHolder(target, source)
    })
    case "publish-static": run(101, func() { publishStatic(owned) })
    default: panic("unknown test")
    }
    fmt.Println("allowed")
}
-- bridge/bridge.go --
// Package bridge is an uninstrumented test-only corruption helper.
package bridge
import "unsafe"
func Set(dst *unsafe.Pointer, value unsafe.Pointer) { *dst = value }
